page.overview:
Who is Aliane Senican?

Aliane held the position for twenty-three years until her death in . She was Doniella Alievin's successor and Suilin Escanda's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Aliane began as a strong Amyrlin, but her notions of running things according only to logic (and her rages when others failed to see her logic) led by to her becoming not so much a puppet of the Hall as ignored by them except when she had to be trotted out for ceremonies.
